title: xAI $5 Billion Secured Debt Financing Arranged by Morgan Stanley
description: xAI completed a $5 billion debt raise structured as secured notes and term loans arranged by Morgan Stanley; the offering was oversubscribed with prominent global debt investors and proceeds support Colossus data center expansion and Grok development. A parallel $5 billion strategic equity investment closed alongside the debt and is noted here for context only; it is not counted in this deal amount.

title: Talen Energy & AWS Revised 17-Year 1,920 MW Front-of-the-Meter Nuclear PPA (~$18B)
description: Following FERC regulatory review, Talen Energy and Amazon Web Services restructured and expanded their nuclear partnership into a landmark 17-year front-of-the-meter Power Purchase Agreement valued at approximately $18 billion, supplying 1,920 MW of zero-carbon baseload energy from the Susquehanna nuclear power station to AWS data centers.

title: Meta $14.3B Investment for 49% of Scale AI
description: Meta invested approximately $14.3B for a 49% non-voting stake in Scale AI at a ~$29B valuation, with founder Alexandr Wang joining Meta to lead its superintelligence unit. Neither company disclosed the dollar figure; the amount is reported by Reuters, CNBC and Bloomberg.

title: Oracle & OpenAI Gigawatt-Scale OCI Cloud Computing Infrastructure Agreement
description: Oracle and OpenAI formalized a multi-year, gigawatt-scale cloud infrastructure agreement utilizing Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) superclusters powered by hundreds of thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs, supporting next-generation reasoning model research and enterprise inference.

title: Anysphere (Cursor) $900M Series C at $9.9B Valuation
description: Anysphere, the maker of AI coding assistant Cursor, raised a $900 million Series C at a $9.9 billion valuation, first reported by Bloomberg on June 5, 2025 and confirmed by the company on June 6. Thrive Capital led the round, with Andreessen Horowitz, Accel and DST Global participating. Anysphere said Cursor had surpassed $500 million in annualized revenue and was used by over half the Fortune 500, including NVIDIA, Uber and Adobe, on tiered $20 Pro / $40 business subscriptions plus newly launched enterprise licenses.

title: Meta and Constellation 20-Year 1,121 MW Clinton Nuclear Power Purchase Agreement
description: Meta signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy for the full 1,121 MW output of the Clinton Clean Energy Center in Illinois beginning in June 2027. The market-based PPA replaces the expiring state Zero Emission Credit program, supports relicensing and 30 MW of plant uprates, preserves over 1,100 jobs, and marks Meta’s first nuclear deal to power AI data center operations in the region.

title: Nebius $1B Convertible Notes Private Placement
description: Nebius Group entered definitive agreements on June 2, 2025 for a $1 billion private placement of senior unsecured convertible notes in two tranches: $500 million of 2.00% notes due 2029 and $500 million of 3.00% notes due 2031, settling June 5, 2025. Goldman Sachs Bank Europe SE acted as sole placement agent. Proceeds fund compute capacity, data center expansion, and general corporate purposes.

title: Stargate UAE: 1GW OpenAI-Led AI Cluster in the 5GW UAE-U.S. AI Campus (G42, OpenAI, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco, SoftBank)
description: OpenAI, G42, Oracle, NVIDIA, Cisco and SoftBank announced on May 22, 2025 the first international deployment of the Stargate platform: Stargate UAE, a 1-gigawatt AI infrastructure cluster to be built by G42 and operated by OpenAI and Oracle inside the newly established 5-gigawatt UAE-U.S. AI Campus in Abu Dhabi (spanning 10 square miles, powered by nuclear, solar and natural gas, and developed under the U.S.-UAE AI Acceleration Partnership in coordination with the U.S. government). The first 200-megawatt cluster is expected to go live in 2026; NVIDIA supplies Grace Blackwell GB300 systems and Cisco provides zero-trust security and AI-ready connectivity. The partnership makes the UAE the first country to enable ChatGPT nationwide, pairs with UAE investment into U.S. Stargate infrastructure, and is designed to serve compute demand within a 2,000-mile radius covering up to half the world’s population. As of late 2026 the project is active, with construction advanced toward the first 200MW phase.

title: OpenAI Merges Jony Ive’s io in ~$6.5 Billion All-Stock Deal
description: OpenAI announced on May 21, 2025 the acquisition of io Products, the secretive AI hardware startup founded by Jony Ive with Scott Cannon, Evans Hankey and Tang Tan, in an all-stock deal of roughly $6.5 billion - OpenAI’s largest acquisition to date - to lead design of AI-native consumer devices. OpenAI already held a ~23% io stake from late 2024, with roughly $5 billion of new stock covering the remaining interest and prior partnership value; about 55 employees joined the company.

title: Crusoe Energy & Blue Owl $15 Billion 1.2 GW Abilene AI Data Center Joint Venture
description: Crusoe Energy, Blue Owl Capital, and Primary Digital Infrastructure expanded their joint venture to $15 billion to build out eight data center facilities totaling 1.2 gigawatts at the Lancium Clean Campus in Abilene, Texas, purpose-designed for NVIDIA GB200 NVL72 liquid-cooled compute clusters.

title: Safe Superintelligence $2 Billion Round at $32B Valuation
description: Safe Superintelligence raised an additional $2 billion at a $32 billion valuation in a Greenoaks-led round with Andreessen Horowitz, Lightspeed, DST Global, Alphabet and NVIDIA participating, despite having no released product.

title: OpenAI $40B Funding Round Led by SoftBank ($300B Valuation)
description: OpenAI raised $40B at a $300B post-money valuation, the largest private technology fundraise on record: $30B from SoftBank plus $10B from a syndicate including Microsoft, Coatue, Altimeter and Thrive, funding research and Stargate infrastructure.

title: CoreWeave $1.5B Nasdaq IPO (CRWV at $40)
description: CoreWeave listed on Nasdaq under ticker CRWV, selling 37.5M Class A shares at $40.00 for approximately $1.5B in proceeds — the largest US tech offering since 2021 — with Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs as joint lead bookrunners.

title: xAI Acquires X in All-Stock Deal Valuing X at $33B
description: xAI acquired social media platform X in an all-stock transaction valuing X at $33 billion in equity ($45 billion enterprise value less $12 billion of debt) and xAI at $80 billion, combining data, models, compute, distribution and talent under a single entity.

title: NVIDIA Acquires GPU Cloud Reseller Lepton AI (Reported Several Hundred Million)
description: NVIDIA acquired Lepton AI, the Cupertino-based startup that rented out NVIDIA GPU servers and offered cloud software for building and scaling AI applications, in a deal The Information reported closed on April 9, 2025 at a value of several hundred million dollars. Neither company officially confirmed the transaction. Co-founders Yangqing Jia (creator of Caffe, ex-Alibaba VP) and Junjie Bai (ex-Meta AI researcher) joined NVIDIA, with Jia listed as VP, System Software from April 2025; NVIDIA relaunched the product as DGX Cloud Lepton in June 2025, deepening its control of how its chips are rented and consumed versus cloud rivals and GPU-cloud partners.

title: SoftBank Acquires Ampere Computing for $6.5 Billion in Cash
description: SoftBank Group acquired 100% of the equity of Ampere Computing Holdings, the Santa Clara-based designer of energy-efficient Arm-based server CPUs, for $6.5 billion in cash. The agreement was entered March 19, 2025 (U.S. time) and announced March 20, 2025; closing completed November 25, 2025 (U.S. time), making Ampere an indirect wholly owned SoftBank subsidiary supporting its AI hardware strategy alongside Arm.

title: NVIDIA Acquires Synthetic Data Startup Gretel in Reported Nine-Figure Deal
description: NVIDIA acquired Gretel, the San Diego-based synthetic-data platform that generates privacy-preserving AI training data, in a deal that had closed by the time of WIRED’s March 19, 2025 report. The price was a nine-figure sum exceeding Gretel’s most recent $320 million valuation, per two people with direct knowledge; NVIDIA never disclosed terms. Gretel’s roughly 80 employees were folded into NVIDIA, where the technology feeds NVIDIA’s generative-AI services and synthetic-data initiatives alongside Omniverse Replicator and Nemotron data-generation models.

title: Google Acquires Wiz for $32 Billion in All-Cash Deal
description: Google completed its $32 billion all-cash acquisition of cloud and AI security platform Wiz on March 11, 2026, roughly a year after announcing the definitive agreement on March 18, 2025. The deal is the largest acquisition in Google history, folds Wiz into Google Cloud, and Wiz retains its brand and multicloud support for AWS, Azure and Oracle customers.

title: Crusoe Energy $225 Million GPU Asset-Backed Credit Facility Led by Upper90
description: Crusoe Cloud secured a $225 million asset-backed credit facility led by Upper90 with participation from British Columbia Investment Management (BCI), King Street Capital, and ORIX USA, collateralized against NVIDIA H100 and A100 GPU clusters.

title: OpenAI $11.9B Five-Year Compute Contract with CoreWeave
description: OpenAI committed to pay CoreWeave up to $11.9B through a five-year cloud infrastructure contract signed ahead of the CoreWeave IPO, including a $350M OpenAI equity private placement. Follow-on awards in May ($4B) and later in 2025 ($6.5B) brought OpenAI total 2025 commitments to about $22.4B.

title: CoreWeave Acquires ML Developer Platform Weights & Biases (Press-Reported ~$1.7B, Terms Undisclosed)
description: CoreWeave announced on March 4, 2025 that it had reached an agreement to acquire Weights & Biases, the leading ML developer platform for experiment tracking, model/agent evaluation and dataset/versioning tooling, two weeks before CoreWeave's March 2025 Nasdaq IPO. Neither company disclosed the purchase price; technology outlet The Information valued the deal at around $1.7 billion, a figure echoed by Reuters, TechCrunch and CoinDesk. The purchase verticalizes software onto CoreWeave's GPU cloud - an "end-to-end AI cloud platform" from compute to model management, evaluation and monitoring for AI labs and enterprises. The acquisition was completed on May 5, 2025, within the first-half 2025 closing window press reports anticipated, with the Weights & Biases team joining CoreWeave and W&B capabilities positioned as a new entry point into the CoreWeave Cloud platform.

title: Anthropic $3.5B Series E at $61.5B Valuation
description: Anthropic raised $3.5B in a Series E led by Lightspeed Venture Partners at a $61.5B post-money valuation, with participation from Bessemer, Cisco Investments, Fidelity, General Catalyst, Jane Street, Salesforce Ventures and others.

title: Lambda $480M Series D Co-Led by Andra Capital and SGW
description: Lambda raised a $480 million Series D co-led by Andra Capital and SGW (the family office of early Google investor Scott Hassan) with participation from NVIDIA, ARK Invest, G Squared, Andrej Karpathy, Fincadia Advisors, In-Q-Tel, KHK & Partners, and others, plus strategic investment from Pegatron, Supermicro, Wistron, and Wiwynn and existing investors including 1517 and Crescent Cove. Total equity raised reached $863 million; proceeds expand the Lambda Cloud platform, inference API, and AI assistant.

title: Together AI $305 Million Series B Financing Round at $3.3 Billion Valuation
description: Together AI raised $305 million in Series B financing co-led by General Catalyst and Prosperity7 Ventures (Aramco Ventures) at a $3.3 billion valuation, with participation from NVIDIA, Salesforce Ventures, and Coatue to expand its AI cloud and GPU clusters.

title: Energy Transfer 1.2 GW Behind-the-Meter Power & Gas Supply Agreements
description: Energy Transfer contracted with multiple hyperscale AI data center developers to supply dedicated natural gas pipeline interconnects feeding over 1.2 gigawatts of behind-the-meter baseload gas turbine electric generation.

title: Google $1B Additional Investment in Anthropic
description: Google agreed a fresh investment of more than $1 billion in Anthropic, reported January 22, 2025 (FT reporting relayed by Reuters and confirmed to CNBC), lifting Google’s total Anthropic backing above $3 billion on top of its earlier $2B commitment and cloud contract. Neither company officially confirmed the figure.

title: The Stargate Project $500 Billion U.S. AI Supercomputing Infrastructure Venture
description: OpenAI, SoftBank Group, Oracle, and MGX announced the Stargate Project at the White House, committing up to $500 billion over four years to build gigawatt-scale AI data center campuses and energy infrastructure across the United States, launching with an immediate $100 billion initial deployment phase.

title: Applied Digital-Macquarie $5B HPC Investment Partnership
description: Macquarie Asset Management funds took a 15% stake in Applied Digital HPC business and committed up to $5B supporting over 2 GW of HPC data center development, starting with up to $900M into the Ellendale, ND campus. First funding milestone executed October 2025.

title: Perplexity $500 Million Round at $9B Valuation
description: Perplexity closed a $500 million round led by Institutional Venture Partners at a $9 billion valuation, tripling its valuation within six months, with NVIDIA, SoftBank and NEA among round investors.

title: xAI $6 Billion Series C Financing Round to Expand Memphis Colossus Supercomputer
description: xAI closed an upsized $6 billion Series C equity funding round at a $50 billion post-money valuation to scale its flagship Memphis Colossus supercomputer cluster from 100,000 to 200,000 GPUs, deploying NVIDIA Blackwell systems.

title: Crusoe $600M Series D Led by Founders Fund
description: Crusoe closed a $600 million Series D at a $2.8 billion valuation led by Founders Fund, with participation from Fidelity, Long Journey Ventures, Mubadala, NVIDIA, Ribbit Capital, and Valor Equity Partners. Proceeds fund expansion of its vertically integrated AI cloud and data centers, including the Abilene, Texas campus; Crusoe Cloud reached general availability alongside the raise.

title: Nscale $155 Million Series A Funding for Liquid-Cooled AI GPU Infrastructure
description: Nscale completed an oversubscribed $155 million Series A funding round led by Sandton Capital Partners, expanding its vertically integrated direct liquid cooling data center pipeline from 300 MW to 1.3 GW across Europe and North America.

title: Meta 1 to 4 Gigawatt Nuclear Energy Request for Proposals (RFP)
description: Following the cancellation of its first nuclear site and facing multi-gigawatt energy needs for its 1 GW Prometheus cluster in Ohio, Meta issued a formal public Request for Proposals (RFP) seeking 1 to 4 GW of new nuclear generation capacity (SMRs and large reactors) starting early 2030s.

title: Nebius Group $700 Million Private Placement Financing with NVIDIA and Accel
description: Nebius Group raised $700 million via private placement of Class A shares at $21.00 per share with strategic participation from NVIDIA, Accel, and institutional asset managers to fund the aggressive expansion of full-stack AI cloud infrastructure in the U.S. and Europe.

title: Amazon Additional $4B Anthropic Investment (Total $8B)
description: Amazon invested an additional $4B in Anthropic, bringing its total commitment to $8B while retaining a minority position. Anthropic named AWS its primary cloud and training partner, deploying Trainium and Inferentia chips for frontier models.

title: Google & Intersect Power Multi-Gigawatt Clean Energy & Storage Framework
description: Alphabet/Google signed a multi-gigawatt clean energy framework agreement with clean infrastructure developer Intersect Power to supply dedicated carbon-free solar and battery storage generation to Google AI data center clusters.

title: CoreWeave $650 Million Strategic Investment Round with Cisco at $23B Valuation
description: CoreWeave completed a $650 million secondary transaction and strategic investment round including Cisco Investments, Jane Street, and Fidelity at a $23 billion valuation, paving the way for its Form S-1 registration and Nasdaq listing (CRWV).

title: CyrusOne, KKR & ECP $4.0 Billion Bosque County 190 MW AI Campus Joint Venture
description: CyrusOne formed a $4.0 billion joint venture with owners KKR and Energy Capital Partners (ECP) to develop a 190-megawatt high-density liquid-cooled computing campus in Bosque County, Texas, designed specifically for AI model training clusters.

title: Meta Aborted Nuclear AI Data Center Colocation & Environmental Stoppage
description: Meta negotiated a direct behind-the-meter AI data center colocation deal with an operating US nuclear power plant, but the project was halted after environmental reviews discovered a rare protected bee species on adjacent land, prompting Mark Zuckerberg to criticize US regulatory delays.

title: FERC Order Rejecting Talen Energy & AWS Susquehanna Nuclear Colocation ISA
description: The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) voted 2-1 on November 1, 2024, to reject an amended Interconnection Service Agreement allowing Amazon Web Services to expand its direct behind-the-meter colocation at the Susquehanna nuclear power station from 300 MW to 480 MW following protests by AEP and Exelon over cost-shifting.

title: Amazon & Dominion Energy Strategic Small Modular Reactor (SMR) Power Agreement
description: Amazon and Dominion Energy entered into an agreement to jointly explore and develop small modular nuclear reactors (SMRs) near North Anna Power Station in Louisa County, Virginia, providing at least 300 MW of zero-carbon baseload power for AWS data centers in Northern Virginia.

title: Amazon $500 Million SMR Anchor Investment in X-energy & Cascade Nuclear Facility
description: Amazon anchored a $500 million financing round for advanced nuclear reactor developer X-energy and partnered with Energy Northwest to construct the Cascade Advanced Energy Facility in Washington state, supporting up to 960 MW of carbon-free SMR nuclear power for AWS cloud and AI regions.

title: Amazon and Energy Northwest Xe-100 SMR Development Agreement (320 MW, up to 960 MW)
description: Amazon and Energy Northwest signed an agreement for Amazon to fund the initial feasibility phase of a small modular reactor project near the Columbia Generating Station in Richland, Washington. The project uses four X-energy Xe-100 modules (320 MW) with Amazon holding the right to purchase first-phase output and an option to expand to twelve modules (960 MW) for Amazon operations and Northwest utilities beginning in the early 2030s.

title: Google & Kairos Power 500 MW Advanced Nuclear Master Agreement
description: Google signed a pioneering corporate master agreement with Kairos Power to develop and deploy a fleet of small modular reactors (SMRs) producing up to 500 megawatts of carbon-free electricity to power Google Cloud AI data centers.

title: Crusoe Energy & Blue Owl Capital $3.4 Billion 200MW AI Data Center JV
description: Crusoe Energy Systems and Blue Owl Capital closed a $3.4 billion joint venture to fund the development and construction of a purpose-built 200 megawatt AI data center in Abilene, Texas, purpose-built for ultra-dense GPU clusters.

title: OpenAI $6.6 Billion Strategic Financing Round at $157B Valuation
description: OpenAI completed a $6.6 billion equity financing round led by Thrive Capital ($1.25B), with participation from Microsoft ($750M), NVIDIA ($100M), and SoftBank ($500M), scaling supercomputing capacity and frontier AI research infrastructure.

title: Constellation & Microsoft 20-Year Crane Clean Energy Center PPA (835 MW)
description: Constellation signed a landmark 20-year power purchase agreement with Microsoft to restart Unit 1 of the Three Mile Island nuclear facility (renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center), providing 835 megawatts of 100% carbon-free power for Microsoft AI data centers.

title: BlackRock, Microsoft, MGX & GIP $30 Billion Global AI Infrastructure Partnership
description: BlackRock, Global Infrastructure Partners (GIP), Microsoft, and MGX launched the Global AI Infrastructure Investment Partnership (GAIIP), targeting $30 billion of private equity capital and up to $100 billion including debt to finance new AI data centers and supporting power infrastructure.

title: Groq & Aramco Digital $1.5 Billion AI Inference Mega-Facility Commitment
description: Groq and Aramco Digital entered into a $1.5 billion sovereign infrastructure commitment to build and scale the world largest AI inference data center in Dammam, Saudi Arabia, offering high-speed LPU compute tokens via Aramco Digital nawat marketplace.

title: Blackstone & CPP Investments A$24 Billion (~US$16B) Acquisition of AirTrunk
description: A consortium led by Blackstone alongside Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPP Investments) completed the landmark acquisition of Asia-Pacific hyperscale data center leader AirTrunk for an enterprise value exceeding A$24 billion (~US$16 billion), the largest data center transaction in history, driven by AI compute demand across APAC.

title: Safe Superintelligence $1 Billion Seed Round at $5B Valuation
description: Safe Superintelligence raised $1 billion at a $5 billion valuation from NFDG, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia, DST Global and SV Angel to acquire computing power and hire researchers across Palo Alto and Tel Aviv.

title: Meta & Sage Geosystems 150 MW Next-Generation Geothermal Power Agreement
description: Meta signed an agreement with Sage Geosystems to purchase up to 150 megawatts of baseload carbon-free power produced via proprietary Geopressured Geothermal Systems (GGS) to supply 24/7 firm clean energy for Meta AI data center operations.

title: AMD $4.9B Acquisition of ZT Systems
description: AMD agreed to acquire hyperscale server designer ZT Systems for $4.9B in cash and stock, including a $400M contingent payment, to integrate rack-scale AI systems challenging Nvidia server integration.

title: STACK Infrastructure $4.0 Billion Cumulative Green Asset-Backed Securitization
description: STACK Infrastructure closed multiple tranches of investment-grade senior secured green asset-backed notes totaling $4.0 billion, securitizing long-term hyperscale data center lease revenues to finance build-to-suit campuses in Stafford County, VA and globally.

title: Groq $640 Million Series D Financing Round Led by BlackRock
description: Inference processor pioneer Groq completed a $640 million Series D funding round led by BlackRock Private Equity Partners at a $2.8 billion valuation, alongside Cisco Investments, Samsung Catalyst Fund, and Neuberger Berman to deploy over 100,000 LPUs.

title: Google Pays ~$2.7 Billion in Licensing Deal with Character.AI; Founders Return
description: Character.AI signed an agreement with Google granting the search giant a non-exclusive license to its large language model technology in a deal reported at ~$2.7 billion, with co-founders Noam Shazeer and Daniel de Freitas plus key researchers returning to Google DeepMind. The structure deliberately avoids an acquisition: no Character.AI shares changed hands, investors and vested employees were paid out, and the company continues operating independently. Follow-on context: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 in October 2026, with Disney named as the $20 million stalking-horse bidder for a non-exclusive perpetual IP license.

title: AMD Acquires Europe’s Largest Private AI Lab Silo AI for $665 Million
description: AMD signed a definitive agreement on July 10, 2024 to acquire Silo AI, Europe’s largest private AI lab, in an all-cash transaction valued at approximately $665 million, and completed the acquisition on August 9, 2024 (completion announced August 12). The Helsinki-based lab behind the SiloGen platform and open-source multilingual LLMs Poro and Viking joined AMD’s Artificial Intelligence Group under Vamsi Boppana, with CEO and co-founder Peter Sarlin continuing to lead the team. Per AMD’s 10-Q, net of closing adjustments, transaction costs and deferred cash compensation, purchase consideration was $553 million, allocated largely to goodwill.

title: Vantage Data Centers $9.2 Billion Hyperscale AI Campus Equity Financing Round
description: Vantage Data Centers closed an upsized $9.2 billion equity investment round led by DigitalBridge and Silver Lake to accelerate the development and construction of hyperscale AI and cloud data center campuses across North America and EMEA.

title: ByteDance Multi-Billion Offshore GPU Leasing via Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
description: ByteDance circumvented US physical export control restrictions by leasing tens of thousands of NVIDIA H100 GPUs directly inside the United States through Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), spending over $2 billion globally on offshore AI compute capacity and Malaysian campuses.

title: QTS Data Centers & Blackstone $25 Billion Hyperscale AI Campus Program
description: Blackstone and QTS Data Centers committed over $25 billion in equity and construction capital to develop gigawatt-scale AI campuses across North America, coordinating directly with regional utilities for multi-gigawatt grid interconnections.

title: Mistral AI €600 Million Series B Financing Round at €5.8B Valuation
description: French frontier AI developer Mistral AI raised €600 million (~$640M USD) comprising €468 million in equity and €132 million in debt in a Series B round led by General Catalyst, alongside NVIDIA, Salesforce, and Bpifrance, valuing the company at €5.8 billion.

title: Alat & Lenovo $2.0 Billion Strategic Investment via Zero-Coupon Convertible Bonds
description: Alat (backed by PIF) completed a $2.0 billion strategic investment in Lenovo Group via 3-year zero-coupon convertible bonds, establishing Lenovo Middle East & Africa headquarters and a sustainable PC and AI server manufacturing hub in Riyadh.

title: xAI $6.0 Billion Series B Funding Round for Colossus Supercluster
description: xAI completed a $6.0 billion Series B round backed by Valor Equity Partners, Vy Capital, Fidelity Management, and Andreessen Horowitz, deploying capital into the Colossus 100,000 NVIDIA H100 cluster in Memphis, TN.

title: CoreWeave $7.5 Billion Senior Debt Facility Led by Blackstone
description: CoreWeave closed a landmark $7.5 billion debt facility led by Blackstone Tactical Opportunities alongside Magnetar Capital, Carlyle, and Coatue to finance massive procurement of NVIDIA Blackwell and H100 GPU clusters and global data center expansion.

title: Apple "Project ACDC" Custom Server Silicon & Private Cloud Compute
description: Apple secretly developed Project ACDC (Apple Chips in Data Center) with TSMC, bypassing NVIDIA GPUs by deploying custom M2 Ultra and M4 Ultra server blades to run Private Cloud Compute AI inference with end-to-end cryptographic privacy.

title: Microsoft & Brookfield Renewable 10.5 GW Global Power Agreement
description: Microsoft and Brookfield Renewable signed the largest corporate renewable energy agreement in history, committing Brookfield to deliver more than 10.5 gigawatts of new clean energy capacity between 2026 and 2030 to power Microsoft global AI cloud expansion.

title: NVIDIA Acquires GPU Orchestration Startup Run:ai (Reported ~$700M)
description: NVIDIA announced a definitive agreement to acquire Run:ai, the Tel Aviv-based maker of Kubernetes-based GPU orchestration and AI workload management software, on April 24, 2024. After the deal was referred to the European Commission under Article 22 on Italy’s request, the Commission cleared it unconditionally on December 20, 2024 (case M.11766), and NVIDIA completed the acquisition on December 30, 2024. Terms were not officially disclosed; sources put the price at ~$700 million. Run:ai’s software continues under NVIDIA and was slated to be open-sourced.

title: Oklo & Equinix 500 MW Advanced Nuclear Power Agreement & $25M Prepayment
description: Global data center operator Equinix entered into a strategic agreement with advanced fission startup Oklo to procure up to 500 megawatts of clean electricity from Oklo Aurora fast-fission powerhouses to power U.S. data centers, supported by a $25 million equity and project prepayment.

title: OpenAI, Jony Ive & LoveFrom $1.0B+ Stealth AI Hardware Venture ("io")
description: Jony Ive and Sam Altman partnered to build a screen-free, multi-modal consumer AI hardware device under stealth entity "io", backed by Laurene Powell Jobs Emerson Collective and seeking over $1.0 billion in institutional capital from SoftBank.

title: Lambda Labs $500 Million GPU-Collateralized Financing Facility
description: Lambda secured a $500 million special purpose vehicle financing facility led by Macquarie Group, using NVIDIA H100 and H200 accelerators as collateral to scale cloud cluster offerings.

title: Applied Digital $160 Million Senior Secured Financing Facility
description: Applied Digital entered into a $160 million senior secured financing facility with Macquarie Group and CIM Group to fund the completion of its flagship Ellendale, North Dakota high-performance AI compute campus.

title: Microsoft Pays ~$650M to License Inflection AI Models and Hire Its Founders and Staff - Not an Acquisition
description: On March 19, 2024 Microsoft announced it had hired Inflection AI co-founders Mustafa Suleyman (to run the newly created Microsoft AI consumer unit as CEO) and Karén Simonyan (chief scientist), along with most of the ~70-person team. Days later, Reuters and Bloomberg reported (person familiar; The Information first) that Microsoft agreed to pay Inflection about $650 million in cash - roughly $620M to license Inflection's models and ~$30M to waive legal claims arising from the mass hiring - in an unusual structure that gave Microsoft the models and the people without buying the company. Inflection's investors were made whole with a modest return (early-round investors around 1.5x per Reuters), no equity changed hands, and Inflection AI continued operating its Pi chatbot independently. The structure drew regulatory attention in both the US (a reported FTC document inquiry) and the UK (a CMA merger review, cleared in September 2024). The license-plus-hire template pioneered here was quickly copied (Amazon-Adept, Google-Character.AI, Meta-Scale AI).

title: Saudi Arabia PIF & a16z $40 Billion AI Mega-Fund ("Project Transcendence")
description: The Public Investment Fund (PIF) of Saudi Arabia held advanced discussions with Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) to anchor a monumental $40 billion venture fund dedicated to artificial intelligence, data centers, chip foundries, and robotics as part of its $100 billion Project Transcendence strategy.

title: Yondr Group $900 Million Project Debt Facility for 300 MW Johor Campus
description: Yondr Group secured an over $900 million syndicated green loan facility to fund the construction of its 300-megawatt hyperscale campus in Johor, Malaysia, supporting expanding regional AI infrastructure across Southeast Asia.

title: AWS $650M Acquisition of Talen Energy Susquehanna Nuclear Campus (960 MW)
description: Amazon Web Services acquired the 960 megawatt Cumulus Data Center campus directly interconnected with the Susquehanna nuclear power station for $650 million, securing long-term carbon-free nuclear power capacity for AWS AI clusters.

title: SoftBank $100 Billion AI Semiconductor Venture ("Project Izanagi")
description: SoftBank founder Masayoshi Son initiated talks to assemble a $100 billion AI chip venture code-named "Project Izanagi", aiming to combine $30 billion of SoftBank capital with $70 billion from Middle Eastern sovereign wealth funds to build an AI semiconductor powerhouse challenging NVIDIA, powered by Arm architecture.

title: Digital Realty & Blackstone $7.0 Billion Hyperscale Data Center Joint Venture
description: Digital Realty and Blackstone completed a $7.0 billion joint venture to develop four hyperscale AI data center campuses across Frankfurt, Paris, and Northern Virginia, bringing online 500+ megawatts of mission-critical compute capacity pre-leased to global hyperscalers.

title: Northern Data AG €575 Million Debt Financing Facility from Tether
description: Northern Data Group secured a €575 million ($610M USD equivalent) unsecured debt financing facility from Tether Group running through 2030, funding the procurement of NVIDIA H100 supercomputers and data centers for its AI cloud subsidiary Taiga Cloud.

title: Google $2B Anthropic Investment Commitment
description: Google agreed to invest up to $2B in Anthropic via a $500M upfront tranche plus a $1.5B follow-on commitment, structured alongside a major Google Cloud services agreement. Google added another $1B in March 2025.

title: Amazon $4B Strategic Investment and AWS Compute Partnership with Anthropic
description: Amazon completed a $4 billion total minority investment in Anthropic. Anthropic designated AWS as its primary cloud provider for mission-critical workloads, including safety research and future foundation model development, collaborating on AWS Trainium and Inferentia silicon.

title: CoreWeave $2.3 Billion GPU-Collateralized Debt Facility
description: Specialized AI cloud provider CoreWeave secured a $2.3 billion debt facility led by Blackstone and Magnetar Capital, using its fleet of NVIDIA H100 graphics processors as physical loan collateral to fund data center compute expansion.

title: Northern Data €400 Million Acquisition of Damoon Ltd (10,000+ H100 GPUs)
description: Northern Data AG completed the €400 million stock-for-stock contribution-in-kind acquisition of Damoon Limited from Tether, acquiring immediate title to over 10,000 NVIDIA H100 GPUs to seed Taiga Cloud and giving Tether a majority cornerstone equity stake.

title: Microsoft & Helion Energy World-First Fusion Power Purchase Agreement
description: Microsoft signed the first commercial fusion power purchase agreement with Helion Energy, agreeing to off-take at least 50 megawatts of electricity from Helion first planned commercial fusion power plant.

title: Microsoft Multi-Billion Dollar Strategic Investment in OpenAI
description: Microsoft committed a multi-year, multi-billion dollar investment into OpenAI following its 2019 and 2021 investments. Under the agreement, Microsoft Azure serves as OpenAI exclusive cloud provider for all research, product, and API workloads.

title: Anthropic $15.0 Billion Senior Revolving Credit Facility Led by Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan & Citi
description: Anthropic lined up a $15.0 billion multi-bank revolving credit facility arranged by Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, JPMorgan Chase, and Citigroup ahead of its public market debut. The facility provides liquidity buffers and balance-sheet capacity to manage cash flow against massive compute commitments while bridging to anticipated profitability.

title: Meta Platforms $10.5 Billion Multi-Tranche Corporate Bond Issuance for AI Datacenter Infrastructure
description: Meta Platforms executed a $10.5 billion multi-tranche senior unsecured corporate bond offering to fund sustained capital expenditures in AI datacenter infrastructure, custom MTIA silicon deployment, and high-bandwidth network fabrics. The issuance spans 5-year, 10-year, 30-year, and 40-year tranches, pricing with tight spreads over Treasuries and reflecting hyperscaler reliance on investment-grade debt markets for physical AI infrastructure expansions.

title: CoreWeave $6.5 Billion Debt Facility Expansion Led by Blackstone, Carlyle & Coatue
description: CoreWeave expanded its existing borrowing facility to $6.5 billion in an asset-backed debt syndicate co-led by Blackstone, Carlyle, and Coatue Management, alongside participation from BlackRock, DigitalBridge, and Fidelity. The facility is directly collateralized by CoreWeave's contracted enterprise cloud fleet of NVIDIA Blackwell B200 and H100 GPU clusters, cementing private credit's role in financing specialized AI compute buildouts.

title: Vantage Data Centers $9.2 Billion Equity & Debt Expansion Syndicate Led by DigitalBridge & Silver Lake
description: Vantage Data Centers secured a $9.2 billion equity and debt financing syndicate co-led by DigitalBridge and Silver Lake to fund multi-gigawatt hyperscale AI datacenter campus construction across North America and Europe. The facility funds high-voltage electrical substations, liquid-cooling retrofits, and shell infrastructure for tier-1 hyperscalers and frontier AI laboratories.

title: Crusoe Energy $3.4 Billion GPU Datacenter Joint Venture with Blue Owl Capital
description: Crusoe Energy and Blue Owl Capital formed a $3.4 billion joint venture to develop and finance a purpose-built 200MW AI datacenter facility in Texas, tailored for dense GPU training and inference clusters. Blue Owl provided the debt and equity capital package through its digital infrastructure fund, while Crusoe provides turnkey facility operations and zero-carbon energy interconnection.

title: Cohere $500 Million Series D Funding Round at $5.5 Billion Valuation
description: Cohere raised $500 million in a Series D funding round at a $5.5 billion valuation, backed by Cisco Systems, AMD Ventures, Fujitsu, and Canadian export fund Inovia Capital, with participation from NVIDIA. The enterprise-focused frontier model company reported reaching an annualized revenue run-rate of approximately $35 million, focusing on enterprise RAG and multilingual enterprise models.

title: Perplexity AI $500 Million Funding Round at $9.0 Billion Valuation
description: Perplexity AI closed a $500 million institutional funding round led by Institutional Venture Partners (IVP), with participation from SoftBank Vision Fund and NVIDIA, valuing the AI search engine company at $9.0 billion. The round follows accelerating consumer search adoption and enterprise subscription revenues reaching an annualized run-rate of approximately $50 million.

title: Safe Superintelligence (SSI) $1.0 Billion Financing Round at $5.0 Billion Valuation
description: Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), co-founded by former OpenAI chief scientist Ilya Sutskever, Daniel Gross, and Daniel Levy, secured $1.0 billion in capital at a $5.0 billion post-money valuation. Investors included NFDG, Andreessen Horowitz, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and SV Angel. The company is dedicated purely to straight-shot safe superintelligence research with zero near-term product distractions.

title: Mistral AI €1.5 Billion ($1.65B) Convertible Note & GPU Compute Facility with European Consortium
description: Mistral AI secured a €1.5 billion ($1.65 billion) structured convertible note and dedicated GPU compute facility arranged with ASML and a sovereign European infrastructure consortium. The facility provides debt financing and hardware allocations to build sovereign European AI training superclusters ahead of frontier reasoning model milestones.

title: Microsoft $3.3 Billion Wisconsin AI Datacenter Campus Expansion Commitment
description: Microsoft committed an additional $3.3 billion in direct capital expenditures to expand its Mount Pleasant, Wisconsin AI datacenter campus, developing high-density liquid cooling facilities, sub-station electrical hookups, and large-scale Azure AI clusters to support OpenAI and sovereign enterprise workloads.

title: Amazon AWS $11.0 Billion Indiana AI Datacenter Campus Investment Commitment
description: Amazon Web Services (AWS) committed $11.0 billion to construct a flagship AI datacenter campus in St. Joseph County, Indiana. The capital commitment covers multi-hundred megawatt power infrastructure, custom Trainium and Inferentia cluster housing, and advanced datacenter facilities to satisfy surging enterprise demand for generative AI models.
